entities.summary: Brigadier General Raden Panji Nugroho Notosusanto was an Indonesian short story writer turned military historian who served as a professor of history at the University of Indonesia. Born to a noble family in Central Java, he exhibited a high degree of nationalism from a young age. During the Indonesian National Revolution from 1945 to 1949, he saw active service as a member of the Student Army, working reconnaissance. Despite wanting to remain in the military, under the influence of his father he continued his education, eventually enrolling in the faculty of literature at the University of Indonesia.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a military historian and professor at the University of Indonesia, Nugroho Notosusanto contributed to the development of Indonesian historiography, particularly in the field of modern Indonesian history. His work has had a significant impact on the understanding of the country's struggle for independence.
